statement: Test census and proof maturity reporting
mechanism: build/test-infrastructure/not-executed-inventory.json is the census: every case a required category does not execute is named there with its mechanism, its due-ness and its reason. Both halves of the rule read it, tools/ci/policy_validator.py before a run and tools/ci/run_test_category.py after one, so a category cannot report a positive count and zero failures while silently skipping something.

scenarios.positive: 75 not executed cases across five categories, each classified. See architecture.json.
scenarios.negative: A case that is not in the census turns its category red rather than passing. See mutation.json.
scenarios.boundary: A due case may never appear in the census: the validator rejects any entry whose due-ness starts with DUE. The five open F-1 cases are therefore deliberately absent, and the RabbitMQ category stays red on them.
scenarios.failure: A missing or unreadable census is itself a failure, in both halves, rather than a silent pass.
scenarios.recovery: The census is regenerated from the bound TRX results and the sources, so it can be rebuilt and rechecked.

residual: Proof maturity across the whole product is a central report the lead owns. What this repository can state is its own census and the fact that it is enforced, which is what is provided here.
reissuedFor: Finding 0032 F-12: these were written for record 0026, against the discarded freeze and before any production correction. Re-slice 0005 requires the affected gates to be run again, so they are rebound to this correction round and their references point at its evidence.
